observation_law: theta~declared uniform; U independent pricing randomness; Y=C_hat_512_262144(theta,U)+0.25*epsilon, epsilon~N(0,I9). Finite numerical model, not continuum exact prices.
target_estimand: Posterior mean of the 512-step expected discounted payoff, with independent target randomness V. No target-price quantile or continuum accuracy claim.

cases.target_mean_uncertainty_scope: IID neural (theta,V) sample-mean SE plus independent reference SNIS SE; excludes numerical and neural bias

prior_baseline.scope: Independent prior draws ignore every observation; SBC can pass despite incorrect conditioning.

limits: Validation only; the reserved test has no execution path in this script.
Reference is finite-bank importance sampling under the declared finite-MC observation law.
Marginal prior-predictive SBC can pass for a network that ignores data; conditional/joint checks remain necessary.
Target outputs are posterior mean finite-grid expected payoffs with sampling SEs; not price quantiles or continuum certification.
No real-market evidence, no P risk probabilities and no future option-chain forecast.
One frozen architecture, seed and budget; failed gates do not trigger automatic tuning.
